Download a Mithril-certified ImmutableDB and replay it

Usage: dolos bootstrap mithril [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --aggregator <URL>
          the Mithril aggregator to download from; defaults to the configured network's, and is
          required for a custom network [env: DOLOS_MITHRIL_AGGREGATOR=]
      --force
          Replace any data already in storage
      --genesis-vkey <KEY>
          the aggregator's genesis verification key, JSON-hex encoded; defaults to the configured
          network's, and is required for a custom network [env: DOLOS_MITHRIL_GENESIS_VKEY=]
      --skip-if-data
          Exit 0 without bootstrapping when storage already holds a node, as an interrupted replay
          that has committed leaves one for `--continue` to resume; data without one, as a bootstrap
          interrupted before it commits a cursor leaves, and a store this release refuses are errors
          instead
      --download-dir <DOWNLOAD_DIR>
          [default: ./snapshot]
      --verbose
          Enable verbose logging output
      --skip-validation
          Skip the Mithril certificate validation
      --skip-download
          Assume the snapshot is already available in the download dir
      --retain-snapshot
          Retain downloaded snapshot instead of deleting it. A replay that stops at `--stop-epoch`
          keeps it either way, for `--continue --skip-download`
      --download-start <DOWNLOAD_START>
          Start downloading from this immutable file number (inclusive)
      --download-end <DOWNLOAD_END>
          Download up to this immutable file number (inclusive)
      --continue
          Resume an interrupted replay from its committed position, over the data it left in storage
  -c, --config <CONFIG>
          
      --stop-epoch <N>
          Stop once the ledger reaches this epoch
      --chunk-size <CHUNK_SIZE>
          Number of blocks to process in each chunk, more is faster but uses more memory [default:
          500]
  -h, --help
          Print help
